attacks.effect_zh: 從睡眠、灼傷、混亂、麻痺、中毒中隨機選出1種特殊狀態，對手的主戰寶可夢陷入該特殊狀態。該寶可夢已經有的特殊狀態不會被選中。

attacks.name: Unseen Claw
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 60 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果對手的主戰寶可夢處於特殊狀態異常，這個招式追加造成60點傷害。

attacks.name: Super Poison Breath
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
attacks.effect_zh: 對手的主戰寶可夢陷入中毒狀態。

attacks.name: Spike Cannon
attacks.effect: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲4次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式造成20點傷害。

attacks.name: Iron Head
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣直到出現反面為止，每次正面，這個招式造成70點傷害。

attacks.name: Pike
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式也對1隻對手的板凳寶可夢造成20點傷害。

attacks.name: Unlock
attacks.effect: Draw a card.
attacks.effect_zh: 抽1張卡。

attacks.name: Sol Breaker
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
attacks.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢也對自己造成10點傷害。

abilities.name: Rising Road
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon.
abilities.effect_zh: 你的回合中可以使用1次以下效果：如果這隻寶可夢在你的板凳上，可以和你的主戰寶可夢互換。

attacks.name: Silver Cannon
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has an Ability, this attack does 40 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果對手的主戰寶可夢擁有特性，這個招式追加造成40點傷害。

attacks.name: Berserk
attacks.effect: If any of your Benched Pokémon have damage on them, this attack does 50 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果你的板凳寶可夢中有任何一隻帶傷，這個招式追加造成50點傷害。

attacks.name: Clanging Scales
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes +30 damage from attacks.
attacks.effect_zh: 在對手的下個回合，這隻寶可夢受到的招式傷害+30。

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，正面的話，這個招式追加造成50點傷害。

attacks.name: Energy Assist
attacks.effect: Take a {C} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 從能量區拿1個無色能量，貼在1隻板凳寶可夢身上。

attacks.name: Justified Press
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {D} Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果對手的主戰寶可夢是{D}寶可夢，這個招式追加造成30點傷害。

attacks.name: Tantrum
attacks.effect: This Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢陷入混亂狀態。

attacks.name: Primate's Trap
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost 1 {C} more, and its Retreat Cost is 1 {C} more.
attacks.effect_zh: 在對手的下個回合，防禦方寶可夢使用招式需要多付1個{C}能量，撤退所需能量也多1個{C}。

abilities.name: Comatose
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever you attach an Energy from your Energy Zone to it, it is now Asleep.
abilities.effect_zh: 只要這隻寶可夢在主戰位置，每當你從能量區為牠附加能量時，牠就會陷入睡眠。

cards.name: Big Malasada
cards.effect: Heal 10 damage and remove a random Special Condition from your Active Pokémon.
cards.effect_zh: 為你的主戰寶可夢回復10點傷害，並隨機解除1個特殊狀態異常。

cards.name: Fishing Net
cards.effect: Put a random Basic {W} Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.
cards.effect_zh: 從你的棄牌堆隨機抽1隻基礎水系寶可夢加入手牌。

cards.name: Rare Candy
cards.effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it, skipping the Stage 1. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn.
cards.effect_zh: 選擇場上你的1隻基礎寶可夢。如果你的手牌中有能由該寶可夢進化而成的第2階卡，就把那張卡放到該基礎寶可夢身上使其進化，跳過第1階。你不能在你的第一個回合，或對本回合才上場的基礎寶可夢使用這張卡。

cards.name: Rotom Dex
cards.effect: Look at the top card of your deck. Then, you may shuffle your deck.
cards.effect_zh: 查看你牌組最上面的1張卡，之後可以選擇洗牌。

cards.name: Poison Barb
cards.effect: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.
cards.effect_zh: 如果裝備這張卡的寶可夢是你的主戰寶可夢，且受到對手寶可夢招式的傷害，攻擊方寶可夢陷入中毒狀態。

cards.name: Leaf Cape
cards.effect: The {G} Pokémon this card is attached to gets +30 HP.
cards.effect_zh: 這張卡裝備的草系寶可夢HP+30。

cards.name: Acerola
cards.effect: Choose 1 of your Palossand or Mimikyu that has damage on it, and move 40 of its damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
cards.effect_zh: 選擇你的1隻沙丘娃或謎擬Q，且該寶可夢身上必須有傷害，把牠身上40點傷害移動到對手的主戰寶可夢身上。

cards.name: Ilima
cards.effect: Put 1 of your {C} Pokémon that has damage on it into your hand.
cards.effect_zh: 把1隻已受到傷害的自己無色系寶可夢放回手牌。

cards.name: Kiawe
cards.effect: Choose 1 of your Alolan Marowak or Turtonator. Take 2 {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to that Pokémon. Your turn ends.
cards.effect_zh: 選擇你的1隻阿羅拉嘎啦嘎啦或鞭炮龜。從能量區取出2個{R}能量附加到該寶可夢身上。你的回合結束。

cards.name: Guzma
cards.effect: Discard all Pokémon Tool cards attached to each of your opponent's Pokémon.
cards.effect_zh: 棄掉對手每隻寶可夢身上附加的所有裝備卡。

cards.name: Lana
cards.effect: You can use this card only if you have Araquanid in play. Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
cards.effect_zh: 只有在場上有滴蛛霸時，才能使用這張卡。把對手板凳上1隻寶可夢換上主戰位置。

cards.name: Sophocles
cards.effect: During this turn, attacks used by your Alolan Golem, Vikavolt, or Togedemaru do +30 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
cards.effect_zh: 這個回合中，你的阿羅拉隆隆岩、鍬農炮蟲或棘刺牙嘎使用招式時，對對手主戰寶可夢造成的傷害+30。

cards.name: Mallow
cards.effect: Heal all damage from 1 of your Shiinotic or Tsareena. If you do, discard all Energy from that Pokémon.
cards.effect_zh: 為你1隻燈罩夜菇或甜冷美后回復所有傷害。如果這麼做，棄掉該寶可夢身上所有能量。

cards.name: Lillie
cards.effect: Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Stage 2 Pokémon.
cards.effect_zh: 為你1隻第2階寶可夢回復60點傷害。

attacks.name: Tropical Hammer
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，反面的話，這個招式沒有任何效果。

attacks.name: Three Kick Combo
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲3次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式造成50點傷害。

attacks.name: Stuck-In Tackle
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，反面的話，這隻寶可夢也會對自己造成20點傷害。

attacks.name: Burning Bonemerang
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads. If at least 1 of them is heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲2次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式造成70點傷害。如果至少1次是正面，對手的主戰寶可夢陷入灼傷。

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.effect: Discard a {R} Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 棄掉這隻寶可夢身上的1個{R}能量。

attacks.name: Call Forth Cold
attacks.effect: Take a {W} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 從能量區拿1個水系能量，貼在這隻寶可夢身上。

abilities.name: Innards Out
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 50 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.
abilities.effect_zh: 如果這隻寶可夢在主戰位置，且因對手寶可夢的招式傷害被擊倒，對攻擊方寶可夢造成50點傷害。

attacks.name: Spiral Drain
attacks.effect: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 為這隻寶可夢回復20點傷害。

abilities.name: Safeguard
abilities.effect: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex.
abilities.effect_zh: 防止對手的ex寶可夢的招式對這隻寶可夢造成的所有傷害。

attacks.name: Volt Switch
attacks.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched {L} Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 把這隻寶可夢與1隻板凳上的電系寶可夢互換。

abilities.name: Flower Shield
abilities.effect: Each of your Pokémon that has any {P} Energy attached recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.
abilities.effect_zh: 你身上附有任何{P}能量的每隻寶可夢，從所有特殊狀態中恢復，且不會受到任何特殊狀態影響。

attacks.name: Energy Arrow
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Energy attached to that Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式依那隻寶可夢身上附有的每個能量，對1隻對手的寶可夢造成20點傷害。

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 把這隻寶可夢與1隻板凳寶可夢互換。

attacks.name: Signs of Evolution
attacks.effect: Put a random card that evolves from Rockruff from your deck into your hand.
attacks.effect_zh: 從你的牌組隨機抽1張能從岩狗狗進化的卡加入手牌。

attacks.name: High Horsepower
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 40 damage to itself.
attacks.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢也對自己造成40點傷害。

attacks.name: Star Drop
attacks.effect: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式對1隻對手的寶可夢造成40點傷害。

attacks.name: Silver Cannon
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has an Ability, this attack does 40 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果對手的主戰寶可夢擁有特性，這個招式追加造成40點傷害。

attacks.name: Berserk
attacks.effect: If any of your Benched Pokémon have damage on them, this attack does 50 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果你的板凳寶可夢中有任何一隻帶傷，這個招式追加造成50點傷害。

attacks.name: Tantrum
attacks.effect: This Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢陷入混亂狀態。

attacks.name: Pierce the Pain
attacks.effect: This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that have damage on them.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式對1隻已受到傷害的對手寶可夢造成100點傷害。

attacks.name: Anchor Shot
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
attacks.effect_zh: 在對手的下個回合，防禦方寶可夢無法撤退。

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
attacks.effect_zh: 對手的主戰寶可夢陷入灼傷狀態。

attacks.name: Scar-Charged Smash
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 60 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果這隻寶可夢帶傷，這個招式追加造成60點傷害。

attacks.name: Insatiable Striking
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Insatiable Striking attack does +40 damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 在你的下個回合，這隻寶可夢的「貪婪出擊」招式威力+40。

attacks.name: School Storm
attacks.effect: This attack does 40 more damage for each of your Benched Wishiwashi and Wishiwashi ex.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式依你板凳上每隻弱丁魚和弱丁魚ex增加40點傷害。

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式依對手主戰寶可夢身上附有的每個能量增加30點傷害。

abilities.name: Psychic Connect
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may move all {P} Energy from 1 of your Benched {P} Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.
abilities.effect_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以將1隻板凳上超能力系寶可夢身上的所有超能力能量移動到你的主戰寶可夢上。

abilities.name: Offload Pass
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, move all {F} Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
abilities.effect_zh: 如果這隻寶可夢在主戰位置，且因對手寶可夢的招式傷害被擊倒，把這隻寶可夢身上所有{F}能量移動到你1隻板凳寶可夢身上。

attacks.effect_zh: 在你的下個回合，你的寶可夢使用招式時，對對手主戰寶可夢造成的傷害+20。

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
attacks.effect_zh: 對手的主戰寶可夢陷入灼傷狀態。

attacks.name: Pop-Punk
attacks.effect: Discard 3 {R} Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 棄掉這隻寶可夢身上的3個{R}能量。

attacks.name: Fireball Shot
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
attacks.effect_zh: 在你的下個回合，這隻寶可夢無法使用招式。

attacks.name: Hearthflame Dance
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, take 2 {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，正面的話，從能量區取得2個{R}能量，附加到你1隻板凳寶可夢身上。

attacks.name: Binding Snow
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't take any Energy from their Energy Zone to attach to their Active Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 在對手的下個回合，他們不能從能量區取出能量附加到他們的主戰寶可夢身上。

attacks.name: Triple Spin
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲3次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式造成60點傷害。

attacks.name: Box of Surprises
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 70 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon. If tails, heal 30 damage from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，正面的話，這個招式對對手的主戰寶可夢造成70點傷害；反面的話，為對手的主戰寶可夢回復30點傷害。

attacks.name: Large Whirlpool
attacks.effect: Discard a random Energy from among the Energy attached to all Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).
attacks.effect_zh: 從場上所有寶可夢（你和對手皆算）身上附加的能量中，隨機棄掉1個能量。

attacks.name: Strong-Armed Destroyer
attacks.effect: Discard 2 random Energy from among the Energy attached to all Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).
attacks.effect_zh: 從場上所有寶可夢（你和對手皆算）身上附加的能量中，隨機棄掉2個能量。

attacks.name: Sweets Relay
attacks.effect: If 1 of your Pokémon used Sweets Relay during your last turn, this attack does 60 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果你有1隻寶可夢在你的上個回合使用了「甜蜜傳遞」，這個招式追加造成60點傷害。

attacks.name: Frozen Lock
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.
attacks.effect_zh: 在對手的下個回合，他們不能使用手牌中的道具卡。

attacks.name: Hail Prison
attacks.effect: Discard Water2 {W} Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.effect_zh: 棄掉這隻寶可夢身上的2個水{W}能量。對手的主戰寶可夢陷入麻痺。

attacks.name: Spit-Out Shot
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式對1隻對手的板凳寶可夢造成30點傷害。

attacks.name: Wellspring Dance
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack also does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，正面的話，這個招式再對對手1隻板凳寶可夢造成40點傷害。

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
attacks.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢也對自己造成10點傷害。

attacks.name: Thunder Spear
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式對1隻對手的寶可夢造成50點傷害。

abilities.name: Surge Surfer
abilities.effect: If a Stadium is in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.
abilities.effect_zh: 如果場上有場地卡，這隻寶可夢的撤退需求為0。

attacks.name: Heavy Thunder
attacks.effect: 1 other Pokémon (either yours or your opponent's) is chosen at random 1 time. Do 100 damage to the chosen Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 隨機選出1隻其他寶可夢（你的或對手的皆可），對被選中的寶可夢造成100點傷害。

attacks.name: Electric Tail
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，正面的話，對手的主戰寶可夢陷入麻痺狀態。

attacks.name: Buddy Spark
attacks.effect: If Plusle is on your Bench, this attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果你的板凳上有正電拍拍，這個招式再對對手所有板凳寶可夢各造成10點傷害。

attacks.name: Damaging Spark
attacks.effect: This attack also does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has damage on it.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式也對對手每隻已受到傷害的板凳寶可夢造成30點傷害。

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.effect: Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 從能量區拿1個電系能量，貼在這隻寶可夢身上。

attacks.name: Photon Laser
attacks.effect: If you have 5 or more {P} Energy in play, this attack does 60 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果場上有5個以上的{P}能量，這個招式追加造成60點傷害。

attacks.name: Flip Over
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
attacks.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢也對自己造成10點傷害。

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.effect_zh: 對手的主戰寶可夢陷入混亂狀態。

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.effect_zh: 對手的主戰寶可夢陷入混亂狀態。

attacks.name: Psy Turbo
attacks.effect: Take 2 {P} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched {P} Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 從能量區拿2個超能力能量，貼在1隻板凳上的超能力系寶可夢身上。

attacks.name: Fantasia Force
attacks.effect: Take 3 {P} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to your {P} Pokémon in any way you like.
attacks.effect_zh: 從能量區拿3個超能力能量，以你喜歡的方式貼在你的超能力系寶可夢身上。

attacks.name: Past Friends
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Supporter card in your discard pile.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式依你棄牌堆中每張支援者卡增加20點傷害。

abilities.name: Strange Singing
abilities.effect: At the beginning of your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, put a random {P} Pokémon from your deck into your hand.
abilities.effect_zh: 在你回合開始時，如果這隻寶可夢在主戰位置，就從你的牌組中隨機抽出1隻{P}寶可夢放入手牌。

attacks.name: Soul Shot
attacks.effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't, this attack does nothing.
attacks.effect_zh: 棄掉你手牌中的1張卡。如果無法棄掉，這個招式不會發生任何效果。

abilities.name: Disguise
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon is first damaged by an attack after coming into play, prevent that damage.
abilities.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢上場後第一次受到招式傷害時，防止該傷害。

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲1次硬幣。如果正面，在對手的下個回合，防止招式對這隻寶可夢造成的所有傷害及效果。

abilities.name: Refreshing Tea
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may have your opponent shuffle their hand into their deck. For each remaining point that your opponent needs to win, they draw a card.
abilities.effect_zh: 你的回合中可以使用1次以下效果：當你從手牌打出這隻寶可夢讓你的1隻寶可夢進化時，可以讓對手把手牌洗回牌組。對手獲勝所需的剩餘分數每有1分，就抽1張卡。

attacks.name: Zen Shard
attacks.effect: This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式對1隻對手的板凳寶可夢造成70點傷害。

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲2次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式造成20點傷害。

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲3次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式造成30點傷害。

attacks.name: Shatter
attacks.effect: Discard a Stadium in play.
attacks.effect_zh: 棄掉場上的場地卡。

attacks.name: Knocking Hammer
attacks.effect: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
attacks.effect_zh: 棄掉對手牌組最上面的1張卡。

attacks.name: Psykick
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has any {P} Energy attached, this attack does 50 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果這隻寶可夢附有任何{P}能量，這個招式追加造成50點傷害。

attacks.name: Megaton Cannon
attacks.effect: This attack does 140 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式對1隻對手的寶可夢造成140點傷害。在你的下個回合，這隻寶可夢不能攻擊。

attacks.name: Tyrannical Fang
attacks.effect: If you have fewer Pokémon in play than your opponent, this attack does 80 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果你場上的寶可夢數量比對手少，這個招式追加造成80點傷害。

attacks.name: Fling
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式對1隻對手的板凳寶可夢造成30點傷害。

abilities.name: Coordinated Unit
abilities.effect: If you have another Falinks in play, this Pokémon's attacks do +20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon, and this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.
abilities.effect_zh: 如果場上還有另1隻列陣兵，這隻寶可夢的招式對對手主戰寶可夢造成的傷害+20，且這隻寶可夢受到對手寶可夢招式的傷害減少20點。

attacks.name: Cornerstone Dance
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −100 damage from attacks.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲1次硬幣。如果正面，在對手的下個回合，這隻寶可夢受到的招式傷害-100。

attacks.name: Swagger
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲1次硬幣。如果正面，就隨機棄掉對手主戰寶可夢身上的1個能量。

abilities.name: Power of Alchemy
abilities.effect: Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.
abilities.effect_zh: 場上的基礎寶可夢（你和對手皆算）沒有特性。

attacks.name: Merciless Strike
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 50 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果對手的主戰寶可夢帶傷，這個招式追加造成50點傷害。

attacks.name: Smokescreen Shot
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.
attacks.effect_zh: 在對手的下個回合，如果防禦方寶可夢要使用招式，對手需擲硬幣。如果反面，該招式不會發動。

abilities.name: Final Scream
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon.
abilities.effect_zh: 如果這隻寶可夢在主戰位置，且因對手寶可夢的招式傷害被擊倒，對對手所有寶可夢各造成10點傷害。

attacks.name: Whiny Voice
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, look at a random card from your opponent's hand and shuffle it into their deck.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲1次硬幣。如果正面，看對手手牌中隨機1張卡，然後將其洗回牌組。

attacks.name: Fasten Claws
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，正面的話，這個招式追加造成30點傷害。

attacks.name: Crush the Weak
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has more Energy attached than your opponent's Active Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果這隻寶可夢附加的能量比對手主戰寶可夢多，這個招式追加造成50點傷害。

attacks.name: Evil Crash
attacks.effect: Discard a random Energy from both Active Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 從雙方主戰寶可夢身上各隨機棄掉1個能量。

attacks.name: Breakcore
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲1次硬幣。如果正面，就棄掉對手的主戰寶可夢。

abilities.name: Dig Up
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may put 2 random Pokémon Tool cards from your discard pile into your hand.
abilities.effect_zh: 你的回合中可以使用1次以下效果：當你從手牌打出這隻寶可夢讓你的1隻寶可夢進化時，可以把棄牌堆中隨機2張道具卡放入手牌。

attacks.name: Heat-Up Crunch
attacks.effect: Until this Pokémon leaves the Active Spot, this Pokémon's Heat-Up Crunch attack does +30 damage. This effect stacks.
attacks.effect_zh: 在這隻寶可夢離開主戰位置之前，這隻寶可夢的「熾熱啃咬」招式傷害+30。這個效果可以疊加。

attacks.name: Pummel
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，正面的話，這個招式追加造成60點傷害。

attacks.name: Snapping Trap
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot when your opponent's Active Pokémon retreats, this attack does 40 damage to the new Active Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 在對手的下個回合，如果對手的主戰寶可夢撤退時這隻寶可夢在主戰位置，這個招式就對新的主戰寶可夢造成40點傷害。

attacks.name: Dual Blades
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲2次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式造成40點傷害。

attacks.name: Superb Shield
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −80 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex.
attacks.effect_zh: 在對手的下個回合，這隻寶可夢受到對手ex寶可夢招式的傷害-80。

attacks.name: Dragon Dive
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，反面的話，這隻寶可夢也會對自己造成50點傷害。

attacks.name: Feelin' Fine
attacks.effect: Draw a card.
attacks.effect_zh: 抽1張卡。

abilities.name: Carefree Steps
abilities.effect: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.
abilities.effect_zh: 如果這隻寶可夢受到招式傷害，擲硬幣，正面的話，防止該傷害。

attacks.name: Steady Punch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，正面的話，這個招式追加造成30點傷害。

attacks.name: Double-Punching Family
attacks.effect:
This attack is used twice in a row. The second attack does 40 damage.
(If the first attack Knocks Out your opponent's Active Pokémon, the second attack is used after your opponent chooses a new Active Pokémon.)
attacks.effect_zh:
這個招式連續使用兩次。第二次的傷害為40點。
（如果第一次攻擊擊倒對手的主戰寶可夢，第二次攻擊會在對手選出新的主戰寶可夢之後才使用。）

attacks.name: Tail Rap
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲2次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式造成20點傷害。

abilities.name: Portrait
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may look at a random Supporter card from your opponent's hand. Use the effect of that card as the effect of this Ability.
abilities.effect_zh: 你的回合中可以使用1次以下效果：如果這隻寶可夢在主戰位置，可以查看對手手牌中隨機1張支援者卡。以該卡的效果作為這個特性的效果。

attacks.name: Aeroblast
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲2次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式威力+40。

abilities.name: Repelling Wind
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may switch out your opponent's Active Basic Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
abilities.effect_zh: 在你的回合中，你可以把對手的主戰基礎寶可夢換到板凳上。（由對手選擇新的主戰寶可夢。）

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
attacks.effect_zh: 對手的主戰寶可夢陷入睡眠狀態。

attacks.name: Best Punch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，反面的話，這個招式沒有任何效果。

attacks.name: Knuckle Sandwich
attacks.effect: Discard a random Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 隨機棄掉這隻寶可夢身上的1個能量。

abilities.name: Snoozing Habit
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever you attach an Energy from your Energy Zone to it, it is now Asleep.
abilities.effect_zh: 只要這隻寶可夢在主戰位置，每當你從能量區為牠附加能量時，牠就會陷入睡眠。

attacks.name: Teetering Steps
attacks.effect: This Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢陷入混亂狀態。

attacks.name: Blow Through
attacks.effect: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 40 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果場上有場地卡，這個招式追加造成40點傷害。

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式也對你每隻板凳寶可夢造成10點傷害。

abilities.name: Fur Coat
abilities.effect: This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.
abilities.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢受到的招式傷害-20。

attacks.name: Flock
attacks.effect: Put 3 random cards from among Tandemaus and Maushold from your deck onto your Bench.
attacks.effect_zh: 從你的牌組隨機把3張一對鼠和一家鼠放上板凳。

attacks.name: Family Beatdown
attacks.effect: Flip a coin for each Tandemaus and Maushold you have in play. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 依你場上的每隻雙鼠簧和一家鼠各擲1次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式造成60點傷害。

cards.name: Jaw Fossil
cards.effect:
Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Basic {C} Pokémon.
At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
This card can't retreat.
cards.effect_zh:
把這張卡當作HP 40的基礎無色系寶可夢使用。
在你的回合中的任何時候，你都可以把這張卡從場上棄掉。
這張卡不能撤退。

cards.name: Lucky Ice Pop
cards.effect: Heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon. If you healed any damage in this way, flip a coin. If heads, put this Lucky Ice Pop into your hand instead of the discard pile.
cards.effect_zh: 為你的主戰寶可夢回復20點傷害。如果藉此回復了傷害，擲硬幣，正面的話，把這張「幸運冰棒」放回手牌，而不是放進棄牌堆。

cards.name: Sail Fossil
cards.effect:
Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Basic {C} Pokémon.
At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
This card can't retreat.
cards.effect_zh:
把這張卡當作HP 40的基礎無色系寶可夢使用。
在你的回合中的任何時候，你都可以把這張卡從場上棄掉。
這張卡不能撤退。

cards.name: Protective Poncho
cards.effect: As long as the Pokémon this card is attached to is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to that Pokémon by your opponent's attacks and Abilities.
cards.effect_zh: 只要這張卡裝備的寶可夢在你的板凳上，就防止對手的招式和特性對該寶可夢造成的所有傷害。

cards.name: Metal Core Barrier
cards.effect:
If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your opponent's turn.

The {M} Pokémon this card is attached to takes −50 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.
cards.effect_zh:
如果這張卡裝備在你1隻寶可夢身上，在對手回合結束時把它棄掉。

裝備這張卡的{M}寶可夢受到對手寶可夢招式的傷害減少50點。

cards.name: Diantha
cards.effect: Heal 90 damage from 1 of your {P} Pokémon that has 2 or more {P} Energy attached. If you healed any damage in this way, discard 2 {P} Energy from that Pokémon.
cards.effect_zh: 為你1隻附有2個以上{P}能量的{P}寶可夢回復90點傷害。如果藉此回復了傷害，從該寶可夢身上棄掉2個{P}能量。

cards.name: Sightseer
cards.effect: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put all Stage 1 Pokémon you find there into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.effect_zh: 查看你牌組最上面的4張卡。把其中所有第1階寶可夢放入手牌，其餘的卡洗回牌組。

cards.name: Juggler
cards.effect:
You can use this card only if your Pokémon in play have 3 or more different types of Energy attached.

attacks.effect_zh: 隨機選出對手的1隻寶可夢，對其造成160點傷害。

abilities.name: Frozen Flow
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
abilities.effect_zh: 你的回合中可以使用1次以下效果：如果這隻寶可夢在主戰位置，可以把對手的主戰寶可夢換到板凳。（由對手選擇新的主戰寶可夢。）

attacks.name: Storm Blade
attacks.effect: Discard a {L} Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 棄掉這隻寶可夢身上的1個{L}能量。

attacks.name: Brutal Bash
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched {D} Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式依你每隻板凳上的惡系寶可夢造成30點傷害。

attacks.name: Air Crash
attacks.effect: Discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 隨機棄掉對手主戰寶可夢身上的1個能量。

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.effect: Discard the top card of your deck.
attacks.effect_zh: 棄掉你牌組最上面的1張卡。

abilities.name: Sand Slammer
abilities.effect: During Pokémon Checkup, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, do 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon.
abilities.effect_zh: 在寶可夢檢查階段，如果這隻寶可夢在主戰位置，就對對手的每隻寶可夢造成10點傷害。

attacks.name: Heartfelt Shine
attacks.effect: Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 為你所有寶可夢各回復30點傷害。

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.effect: Put a random Pokémon from your deck into your hand.
attacks.effect_zh: 從你的牌組隨機抽1隻寶可夢加入手牌。

attacks.name: Fighting Pulse
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra {F} Energy attached, this attack does 50 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果這隻寶可夢附加了至少1個額外的{F}能量，這個招式追加造成50點傷害。

abilities.name: Time Recall
abilities.effect: Each of your evolved Pokémon can use any attack from its previous Evolutions. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)
abilities.effect_zh: 你的每隻已進化寶可夢都可以使用牠先前進化階段的任何招式。（使用各招式仍需要相應的能量。）

abilities.name: Villainous Delivery
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, your Active {D} Pokémon's Retreat Cost is 1 less.
abilities.effect_zh: 只要這隻寶可夢在你的板凳上，你主戰的{D}寶可夢的撤退所需能量-1。

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.effect: Discard a random Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 隨機棄掉這隻寶可夢身上的1個能量。

attacks.name: Spirited Smack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，反面的話，這個招式沒有任何效果。

attacks.name: Wildly Writhe
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.
attacks.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢也對自己造成60點傷害。

attacks.name: Thermal Gust
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 50 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 120 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲3次硬幣。如果有1次正面，這個招式威力+20。如果有2次正面，這個招式威力+50。如果3次都是正面，這個招式威力+120。

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式依對手主戰寶可夢身上附有的每個能量增加20點傷害。

attacks.name: Impound
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
attacks.effect_zh: 在對手的下個回合，防禦方寶可夢無法撤退。

attacks.name: Cold Start
attacks.effect: If this is the first time this Pokémon has used an attack after coming into play, this attack does 20 more damage, and your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果這是這隻寶可夢上場後第一次使用招式，這個招式追加造成20點傷害，且對手的主戰寶可夢陷入麻痺狀態。

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式也對1隻對手的板凳寶可夢造成10點傷害。

attacks.name: Volt Wave
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，正面的話，對手的主戰寶可夢陷入麻痺狀態。

attacks.name: Successive Slapping
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲2次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式造成70點傷害。

attacks.name: Binary Thunder
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 40 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果對手的主戰寶可夢是Pokémon ex，這個招式追加造成40點傷害。

attacks.name: Hadron Ray
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each {L} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式依這隻寶可夢身上每個電系能量增加20點傷害。

abilities.name: Legendary Drive
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you put this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon. If you do, move all of your Energy in play to this Pokémon.
abilities.effect_zh: 你的回合中可以使用1次以下效果：當你從手牌把這隻寶可夢放上板凳時，可以和你的主戰寶可夢互換。如果這麼做，把你場上所有能量移動到這隻寶可夢身上。

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
attacks.effect_zh: 對手的主戰寶可夢陷入睡眠狀態。

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，正面的話，對手的主戰寶可夢陷入麻痺狀態。

attacks.name: Lumina Crash
attacks.effect: During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes +50 damage from attacks.
attacks.effect_zh: 在你的下個回合，防禦方寶可夢受到的招式傷害+50。

attacks.name: Shooing Shout
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, discard your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲2次硬幣。如果都是正面，就棄掉對手的主戰寶可夢。

attacks.name: Spellbinding Start
attacks.effect: If this is the first time this Pokémon has used an attack after coming into play, during your opponent's next turn, they can't use any Trainer cards from their hand.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果這是這隻寶可夢上場後第一次使用招式，在對手的下個回合，對手無法使用手牌中的任何訓練師卡。

abilities.name: Future System
abilities.effect: Attacks used by your Future Pokémon cost 1 less {C} Energy.
abilities.effect_zh: 你的未來寶可夢使用招式所需的{C}能量-1。

attacks.name: Avenging Edge
attacks.effect: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 50 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果你有寶可夢在對手的上個回合因招式傷害被擊倒，這個招式追加造成50點傷害。

attacks.name: Modular Axe
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 40 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果這隻寶可夢裝備了道具卡，這個招式追加造成40點傷害。

attacks.name: Enumerating Blade
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式依對手每隻板凳寶可夢增加20點傷害。

abilities.name: Blessed Salt
abilities.effect: During Pokémon Checkup, heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.
abilities.effect_zh: 在寶可夢檢查階段，為你的每隻寶可夢治療10點傷害。

attacks.name: Shaking Stomp
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式也對你每隻板凳寶可夢造成20點傷害。

attacks.name: Pull In and Pound
attacks.effect: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, this attack does 50 damage to the new Active Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 把對手板凳上1隻寶可夢換上主戰位置。如果這麼做，這個招式對新的主戰寶可夢造成50點傷害。

attacks.name: World Wrecker

attacks.name: Confuse Ray

attacks.effect_zh: 對手的主戰寶可夢陷入混亂狀態。

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，正面的話，這個招式追加造成20點傷害。

attacks.name: Raid
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon evolved from Sneasel during this turn, this attack does 20 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果這隻寶可夢這回合是從狃拉進化而來，這個招式追加造成20點傷害。

attacks.name: Jeweled Gift
attacks.effect: Take a random Energy from among {G}, {R}, {W}, {L}, {P}, {F}, {D}, and {M} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 從{G}、{R}、{W}、{L}、{P}、{F}、{D}、{M}系能量中隨機從能量區拿1個，貼在1隻板凳寶可夢身上。

attacks.name: Overlord’s Blade
attacks.effect: This attack does 40 more damage for each time your Pokémon have been Knocked Out during this game.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式依你的寶可夢在這場對戰中被擊倒過的次數增加40點傷害。

attacks.name: Venomous Hit
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
attacks.effect_zh: 對手的主戰寶可夢陷入中毒狀態。

abilities.name: Shattering Crystal
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't get any points for it.
abilities.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢被擊倒時，擲一次硬幣。如果正面，對手無法因此得到任何分數。

abilities.name: Automated Combat
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 20 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.
abilities.effect_zh: 如果這隻寶可夢在主戰位置，且受到對手寶可夢招式的傷害，對攻擊方寶可夢造成20點傷害。

abilities.name: Ancient Roar
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you put this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
abilities.effect_zh: 你的回合中可以使用1次以下效果：當你從手牌把這隻寶可夢放上板凳時，可以把對手的主戰寶可夢換到板凳。（由對手選擇新的主戰寶可夢。）

attacks.name: Iron Swing
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲2次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式造成100點傷害。

attacks.name: Roll and Release
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣直到出現反面為止，每次正面，這個招式威力+30。

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，反面的話，這個招式沒有任何效果；正面的話，在對手的下個回合，防止對這隻寶可夢造成的所有傷害及招式效果。

attacks.name: Sweeping Billow
attacks.effect: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 棄掉這隻寶可夢身上的1個能量，這個招式額外對對手板凳上的每隻寶可夢造成20點傷害。

attacks.name: Scorching Interruption
attacks.effect: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −30 damage from attacks.
attacks.effect_zh: 棄掉這隻寶可夢身上的2個能量。在對手的下個回合，這隻寶可夢受到的招式傷害-30。

attacks.name: Baneful Boom
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. Knock Out your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 棄掉這隻寶可夢身上的所有能量，擊倒對手的主戰寶可夢。

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，正面的話，防禦方寶可夢在對手的下個回合無法攻擊。

attacks.name: Double Hit
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲2次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式造成60點傷害。

attacks.name: Sudden Drilling
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon evolved from Dunsparce during this turn, discard 2 random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果這隻寶可夢這回合是從土龍弟弟進化而來，從對手主戰寶可夢身上隨機棄掉2個能量。

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲3次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式造成10點傷害。

attacks.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢也對自己造成20點傷害。

attacks.effect_zh: 擲2次硬幣，每次正面，這個招式威力+20。

attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣，反面的話，這個招式沒有任何效果。

attacks.name: Nosedive
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
attacks.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢也對自己造成20點傷害。

attacks.name: Prism Impact
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each type of Energy attached to this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式依這隻寶可夢身上附有的每種能量類型增加20點傷害。

cards.name: Ancient Booster Energy Capsule
cards.effect: The Ancient Pokémon this card is attached to gets +40 HP.
cards.effect_zh: 這張卡裝備的古代寶可夢HP+40。

cards.name: Future Booster Energy Capsule
cards.effect: Attacks used by the Future Pokémon this card is attached to do +20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
cards.effect_zh: 這張卡裝備的未來寶可夢使用招式時，對對手主戰寶可夢造成的傷害+20。

cards.name: Juliana
cards.effect: Put a random Stage 2 Pokémon from your deck into your hand.
cards.effect_zh: 從你的牌組隨機抽1隻第2階寶可夢加入手牌。

cards.name: Professor Sada
cards.effect: Attach 3 different types of Energy from your discard pile to your Ancient Pokémon in any way you like.
cards.effect_zh: 從你的棄牌堆中取出3種不同屬性的能量，以任意方式附加到你的古代寶可夢身上。

cards.name: Professor Turo
cards.effect: Shuffle 1 of your Future Pokémon in play into your deck.
cards.effect_zh: 把場上1隻你的未來寶可夢洗回你的牌組。

cards.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, put a random Item card from your deck into your hand.
cards.effect_zh: 擲1次硬幣。如果正面，從你的牌組中隨機抽出1張道具卡放入手牌。

cards.name: Claw Fossil
cards.effect:
Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Basic {C} Pokémon.
At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
This card can't retreat.
cards.effect_zh:
把這張卡當作HP 40的基礎無色系寶可夢使用。
在你的回合中的任何時候，你都可以把這張卡從場上棄掉。
這張卡不能撤退。

cards.name: Root Fossil
cards.effect:
Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Basic {C} Pokémon.
At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
This card can't retreat.
cards.effect_zh:
把這張卡當作HP 40的基礎無色系寶可夢使用。
在你的回合中的任何時候，你都可以把這張卡從場上棄掉。
這張卡不能撤退。

cards.name: Deceptive Needle
cards.effect: At the end of your turn, if the {D} Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, do 10 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
cards.effect_zh: 在你回合結束時，如果這張卡裝備的{D}寶可夢在主戰位置，就對對手的主戰寶可夢造成10點傷害。

cards.name: Clear Veil
cards.effect: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to the Pokémon this card is attached to. (Existing effects are not removed.)
cards.effect_zh: 防止對手寶可夢的招式效果影響這張卡所裝備的寶可夢。（已經存在的效果不會被移除。）

cards.name: Psychic
cards.effect:
You can use this card only if your Pokémon in the Active Spot has the Psychic attack.

Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and move a random Energy from it to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
cards.effect_zh:
只有在你主戰位置的寶可夢擁有「精神強念」招式時，才能使用這張卡。

選擇1隻對手板凳上的寶可夢，把牠身上隨機1個能量移動到對手的主戰寶可夢身上。

cards.name: Drayden
cards.effect: During this turn, 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen 1 more time for the Draco Meteor attack used by your Pokémon.
cards.effect_zh: 這個回合中，你的寶可夢使用「流星群」招式時，額外多選中對手的1隻寶可夢1次。

cards.name: Skyla
cards.effect: Switch your Active Stage 1 Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
cards.effect_zh: 把你的主戰第1階寶可夢與1隻板凳寶可夢互換。

cards.name: Wally
cards.effect: Take a {C} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Stage 2 Pokémon.
cards.effect_zh: 從能量區拿1個無色能量，貼在1隻你的第2階寶可夢身上。

cards.name: Soothing Shore
cards.effect: At the end of each player's turn, that player heals 20 damage from each of their Pokémon that has any {W} Energy attached.
cards.effect_zh: 在每位玩家回合結束時，該玩家為每隻身上附有{W}能量的寶可夢治療20點傷害。

cards.name: Rainbow Cave
cards.effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard the Energy that has been generated in their Energy Zone. If they do, the next Energy is produced.
cards.effect_zh: 每位玩家的回合中可以使用1次以下效果：該玩家可以棄掉能量區已產生的能量。如果這麼做，會產生下一個能量。

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 為這隻寶可夢回復10點傷害。

attacks.name: Deck and Cover
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Paralyzed. Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.
attacks.effect_zh: 對手的主戰寶可夢陷入中毒和麻痺狀態。把這隻寶可夢和裝備在牠身上的所有卡洗回你的牌組。

attacks.name: Stoke
attacks.effect: Take a {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 從能量區拿1個火系能量，貼在這隻寶可夢身上。

attacks.name: Heat Wave
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
attacks.effect_zh: 對手的主戰寶可夢陷入灼傷狀態。

attacks.name: Tidal Blast
attacks.effect: Discard 3 {W} Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 棄掉這隻寶可夢身上的3個{W}能量，這個招式對對手的每隻寶可夢造成50點傷害。

attacks.name: Pike
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式也對1隻對手的板凳寶可夢造成20點傷害。

abilities.name: Stance
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn.
abilities.effect_zh: 你的回合中可以使用1次以下效果：當你從手牌打出這隻寶可夢讓你的1隻寶可夢進化時，可以防止對手寶可夢的招式對這隻寶可夢造成的所有傷害及效果，直到對手下個回合結束為止。

abilities.name: Evoshock
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
abilities.effect_zh: 你的回合中可以使用1次以下效果：當你從手牌打出這隻寶可夢讓你的1隻寶可夢進化時，可以擲硬幣，正面的話，對手的主戰寶可夢陷入麻痺狀態。

attacks.name: Mini-Metronome
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲1次硬幣。如果正面，選擇對手主戰寶可夢的1個招式，作為這個招式使用。

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.effect: Put a random Supporter card from your deck into your hand.
attacks.effect_zh: 從你的牌組隨機抽1張支援者卡加入手牌。

attacks.name: Stompy Jammer
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost 1 {C} more.
attacks.effect_zh: 在對手的下個回合，防禦方寶可夢使用招式需要多付1個{C}能量。

attacks.name: Supernatural Feather
attacks.effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't, this attack does nothing.
attacks.effect_zh: 棄掉你手牌中的1張卡。如果無法棄掉，這個招式不會發生任何效果。

attacks.name: Team Hunt
attacks.effect: Draw a card for each Poochyena you have in play.
attacks.effect_zh: 依你場上每隻小狼崽，抽取對應張數的卡。

attacks.name: Run Around
attacks.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 把這隻寶可夢與1隻板凳寶可夢互換。

attacks.name: Techno Blast
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
attacks.effect_zh: 在你的下個回合，這隻寶可夢無法使用招式。

abilities.name: Dragon’s Blessing
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may attach an Energy from your discard pile to your Active {N} Pokémon.
abilities.effect_zh: 你的回合中可以使用1次以下效果：如果這隻寶可夢在你的板凳上，可以從棄牌堆取得1個能量，附加到你主戰的{N}寶可夢身上。

attacks.name: Draco Meteor
attacks.effect: 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen at random 3 times. For each time a Pokémon was chosen, do 60 damage to it.
attacks.effect_zh: 隨機選出對手的1隻寶可夢，重複3次。每次被選中的寶可夢，造成60點傷害。

attacks.name: Acceleration Drive
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲1次硬幣。如果正面，在對手的下個回合，防止招式對這隻寶可夢造成的所有傷害及效果。

abilities.name: Treasure Collecting
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put all Item cards you find there into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
abilities.effect_zh: 你的回合中可以使用1次以下效果：當你從手牌打出這隻寶可夢讓你的1隻寶可夢進化時，可以查看你牌組最上面的4張卡，把其中所有道具卡放入手牌，其餘的卡洗回牌組。

attacks.name: Chase Order
attacks.effect: You may discard 1 of your Benched Basic {G} Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 70 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 你可以棄掉1隻你板凳上的基礎草系寶可夢。如果這麼做，這個招式傷害+70。

attacks.name: Destructive Inferno
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 擲硬幣直到出現反面為止。每次正面，就隨機棄掉對手主戰寶可夢身上的1個能量。

attacks.name: Turbo Shark
attacks.effect: Take a {W} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched {W} Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 從能量區拿1個水系能量，貼在1隻板凳上的水系寶可夢身上。

attacks.name: Wondrous Waves
attacks.effect: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.
attacks.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢從所有特殊狀態中恢復。

attacks.name: Junk Spark
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 more damage for each Item card in your discard pile.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式依你的棄牌堆中每張道具卡增加10點傷害。

attacks.name: Resonating Blade
attacks.effect: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 50 more damage.
attacks.effect_zh: 如果你這回合從手牌中打出過支援者卡，這個招式追加造成50點傷害。

attacks.name: Shadow Bullet
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式也對1隻對手的板凳寶可夢造成20點傷害。

attacks.name: Dynamite Punch
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
attacks.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢也對自己造成20點傷害。

attacks.name: Gatling Slug
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 more damage for each {M} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
attacks.effect_zh: 這個招式依這隻寶可夢身上每個鋼系能量增加10點傷害。

attacks.name: Mega Burst
attacks.effect: Discard all {R} and {L} Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 50 damage for each Energy you discarded in this way.
attacks.effect_zh: 棄掉這隻寶可夢身上的所有{R}能量和{L}能量，這個招式依此方式棄掉的每個能量造成50點傷害。

attacks.name: Jet Wing
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
attacks.effect_zh: 在你的下個回合，這隻寶可夢無法使用招式。

attacks.name: 野性電擊
attacks.effect: 這隻寶可夢也受到30點傷害。
attacks.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢也受到30點傷害。

abilities.name: 渦輪電壓
abilities.effect: 可以自由將電系能量從板凳寶可夢移轉到戰鬥寶可夢上
abilities.effect_zh: 可以自由將電系能量從板凳寶可夢移轉到戰鬥寶可夢上

attacks.name: 青焰
attacks.effect: 可給予1隻自己的板凳火屬性寶可夢1個火屬性能量。
attacks.effect_zh: 可給予1隻自己的板凳火屬性寶可夢1個火屬性能量。

abilities.effect: 可以自由將火系能量從板凳寶可夢移轉到戰鬥寶可夢上。
abilities.effect_zh: 可以自由將火系能量從板凳寶可夢移轉到戰鬥寶可夢上。

attacks.name: 絕對零度
attacks.effect: 若對手的戰鬥寶可夢為進化寶可夢，則增加60點傷害。
attacks.effect_zh: 若對手的戰鬥寶可夢為進化寶可夢，則增加60點傷害。

abilities.name: 冰封世界
abilities.effect: 對手寶可夢撤退所需能量+2。
abilities.effect_zh: 對手寶可夢撤退所需能量+2。

abilities.name: 覺醒
abilities.effect: 這隻寶可夢在場上度過一個回合後，可以從你的牌組將一張「烈咬陸鯊」直接疊在這張卡上進化。
abilities.effect_zh: 這隻寶可夢在場上度過一個回合後，可以從你的牌組將一張「烈咬陸鯊」直接疊在這張卡上進化。

cards.name: 彩虹能量
cards.effect: 選擇一種屬性的能量，附有這張卡的寶可夢額外擁有一個該屬性的能量。

cards.name: 流星之民的祈禱
cards.effect: 選擇兩個屬性，從能量區抽取選擇屬性的能量到場上的寶可夢上。回合結束。
